quote: Eternity is in love with the productions of time.
source: William Blake, The Marriage of Heaven and Hell, Proverbs of Hell, plate 7 (1790)

evidence.where: Known text of the Proverbs of Hell (Erdman, Complete Poetry and Prose of William Blake), where it is the tenth proverb, on plate 7; no web page opened for this run
evidence.edition: The Marriage of Heaven and Hell, etched c. 1790, text as in David V. Erdman, ed., Complete Poetry and Prose (1965, rev. 1982)

reason: A Proverb of Hell on plate 7, in exactly this wording. It is an authored proverb, not an anonymous tradition, so it is in scope. Blake is at 0 of 3; the carry-in 05-poet-07 is also a Blake proverb from the same plate, so only one of the two can stand in November.
